name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

name: Chansey
flavour_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Meowth
flavour_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Butterfree
flavour_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Mankey
flavour_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Greninja
flavour_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Onix
flavour_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

name: Magnemite
flavour_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Snivy
flavour_text: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Volcarona
flavour_text: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Piplup
flavour_text: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

name: Turtwig
flavour_text: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.

name: Electivire
flavour_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Misdreavus
flavour_text: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Skarmory
flavour_text: People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.

name: Chimchar
flavour_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

name: Togepi
flavour_text: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: Cherrim
flavour_text: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Nosepass
flavour_text: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it’s in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

name: Gible
flavour_text: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

name: Staraptor
flavour_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Manaphy
flavour_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Cyclizar
flavour_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Sprigatito
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Riolu
flavour_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Farfetch'd
flavour_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Rayquaza
flavour_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

name: Cosmog
flavour_text: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn’t seem to care.

name: Lycanroc
flavour_text: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

name: Alolan Exeggutor
flavour_text: Blazing sunlight has brought out the true form and powers of this Pokémon.

name: Alolan Ninetales
flavour_text: A deity resides in the snowy mountains where this Pokémon lives. In ancient times, it was worshiped as that deity’s incarnation.

name: Crabrawler
flavour_text: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

name: Alolan Grimer
flavour_text: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola’s waste-disposal site. They’re all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

name: Toucannon
flavour_text: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Kartana
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast’s body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

name: Blacephalon
flavour_text: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Xurkitree
flavour_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: Dawn Wings Necrozma
flavour_text: Lunala no longer has a will of its own. Now under the control of Necrozma, it continuously expels all of its energy.

name: Dusk Mane Necrozma
flavour_text: This is its form while it is devouring the light of Solgaleo. It pounces on foes and then slashes them with the claws on its four limbs and back.

name: Stakataka
flavour_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Poipole
flavour_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Alcremie
flavour_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Audino
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Cleffa
flavour_text: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

name: Horsea
flavour_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Chinchou
flavour_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: Kangaskhan
flavour_text: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

name: Latias
flavour_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Tropius
flavour_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Poliwag
flavour_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

name: Milotic
flavour_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavour_text: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Miltank
flavour_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Phanpy
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Machamp
flavour_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Regigigas
flavour_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Shaymin
flavour_text: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
